messages:
nina: Opening a docs PR to merge the v1->v2 migration notes for /chat and /models. Will include quick checklist, code diffs (TS + Py), redirect guidance, and a deprecation banner. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/YYYY

raj: Please add a tiny streaming example showing the new chunk/event framing. That tripped a customer last month.

nina: Will add. Also adding a short note about SDK shims that can be removed.

omar: Engineering plans to flip the alias map Tuesday 09:00 PT. Docs need to be live beforehand or we keep redirects for 48h.

nina: Targeting merge by Monday EOD. If delayed, we'll hold the flip.

raj: Add a CI compat job that runs the TS and Py snippets against staging and fails if output shapes change (label opt-out allowed).

nina: Added to checklist: snippet tests, redirects, changelog, sample app update, deprecation banner.

doc-bot: Reminder scheduled: ping #eng-releases at 08:30 PT on 2173456800 for alias flip.

omar: Also include an embeddings checklist: sanity eval snippet since tokenization/embedding dims change slightly.

nina: Done. Assigning reviewers: @raj for runtime, @omar for rollout. Will ping when PR is ready for review. :thumbsup:
